title: Transport of the represented identity generator
statement: Let $S,Y,Y\prime$ be schemes and $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$ with $h\circ a=h\prime$, and let $U\to S$ be etale. Let $A$ be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf represented by $U$, and put $G=h^*A$, $G\prime=h\prime^*A$, as in [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Let $e:a^*G\cong G\prime$ be the inverse of the inverse-image composition comparison. Write $\xi_h=z_h^{-1}(\mathrm{generator}(h,U))$ and $\xi_{h\prime}=z_{h\prime}^{-1}(\mathrm{generator}(h\prime,U))$, with the zero comparisons and represented identity generators of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. For the explicitly constructed ordinary-section transport $b_G$ of [lem-sbc-restricted-derived-evaluation-pullback], $b_G(\xi_h)=\xi_{h\prime}$. No target coefficient sheaf or higher derived-Hom class is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Identify sectionsIso W G inverse with etaleObjectSectionsIso W hom by unfolding their constructions and applying naturality of the terminal-evaluation isomorphism. Apply etaleObjectSections_baseChange to q = rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h′ w U; its two projection equations follow from pullback.map. Factor rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient as the square comparison followed by r′ inverse image of the coefficient map. Naturality of etaleObjectSectionsIso in that map and cancellation of sectionsIso at the target give the ordinary section pullback square for arbitrary G, G′ and psi.

Apply upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app to A = freeSheaf S U and the triangle a followed by h = h′. Expand the composite adjunction unit, postcompose with h′ direct image of the inverse composition comparison, and cancel its hom/inv pair. Evaluate the resulting sheaf-morphism identity at U. This gives eta_h followed by eta_a, the direct-image composition comparison, and the inverse coefficient comparison equals eta_h′.

Evaluate the ordinary section square at eta_h(U) of the explicitly sheafified represented identity element. Substitute the evaluated unit identity from step 2. Injectivity of sectionsIso W′ G′ hom, an isomorphism, gives that the ordinary section map sends generator h U to generator h′ U. Unfold transportZero, cancel source zeroIso hom with its inverse, and apply target zeroIso inverse to this generator identity.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedComparison_generator_pullback {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (U : S.Etale) :
    transportZero a h h' w
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h).obj (freeSheaf S U))
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h').obj (freeSheaf S U))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a h h' w.symm).inv.app (freeSheaf S U)) U
      ((zeroIso ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj U)
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h).obj (freeSheaf S U))).inv (generator h U)) =
    (zeroIso ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h').obj U)
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h').obj (freeSheaf S U))).inv (generator h' U)
